examples.question_text:
Euler's number is $e=2.71828182845\ldots$.
(a) Round $e$ to five decimal places.
(b) State the property of the tangent to $y=e^x$ at $(0,1)$ that distinguishes this base.
examples.solution_text:
(a) The sixth decimal digit is $1$, so $e\approx2.71828$.

(b) The tangent at $(0,1)$ has gradient exactly $1$. Euler's number is the unique base with this property.

examples.question_text:
For $f(x)=e^x$:
(a) Write down $f'(x)$.
(b) Find the gradient of the tangent at the point where $y=\dfrac{7}{4}$.
examples.solution_text:
(a) $f'(x)=e^x$.

(b) The gradient equals the function value, so $m=\dfrac{7}{4}$.

examples.question_text:
Use a calculator to evaluate each expression correct to three significant figures. First rewrite the reciprocal and root expressions as single powers of $e$.
(a) $e^4$
(b) $\dfrac{1}{e^4}$
(c) $-\sqrt{e^7}$

The mass of a decaying substance is $M(t)=90e^{-0.04t}$ grams, where $t$ is measured in days.
(a) Find the initial mass.
(b) Find the exact mass after $25$ days in terms of $e$, then evaluate it to two decimal places.
examples.solution_text:
(a) $\begin{aligned}M(0)&=90e^{-0.04(0)}\\&=90e^0\\&=90\end{aligned}$
The initial mass is $90\text{ g}$.

(b) $\begin{aligned}M(25)&=90e^{-0.04(25)}\\&=90e^{-1}\\&=\frac{90}{e}\\&\approx33.11\end{aligned}$
The exact mass is $\dfrac{90}{e}\text{ g}$; to two decimal places it is $33.11\text{ g}$.

examples.question_text: A population grows according to $N(t)=450e^{0.015t}$, where $t$ is measured in months. Find the population after $3$ years, rounding to the nearest individual.
examples.solution_text:
$3$ years is $36$ months.

$\begin{aligned}N(36)&=450e^{0.015(36)}\\&=450e^{0.54}\\&\approx772\end{aligned}$
The population is approximately $772$ individuals.

examples.derivation: The sixth decimal digit of 2.71828182845… is 1, giving 2.71828 to five decimal places. Source lines 38–43 identify e as the unique base whose tangent at (0,1) has gradient 1.
Differentiating f(x)=e^x gives f'(x)=e^x=f(x). Therefore the tangent gradient where y=7/4 is 7/4, following source lines 625–641 and 653–667.

e^4=54.598150… rounds to 54.6; 1/e^4=e^(-4)=0.0183156… rounds to 0.0183; -sqrt(e^7)=-e^(7/2)=-33.115452… rounds to -33.1. All use three significant figures. Reciprocal and root working includes the required phantom equals gutters.
M(0)=90e^0=90 g. At 25 days, -0.04(25)=-1, so M(25)=90/e g=33.109149… g, rounding to 33.11 g. Substitution follows source Foundation Q2; equations align at their relation signs.
Three years equals 36 months. N(36)=450e^(0.015×36)=450e^0.54=772.203088…, giving 772 individuals. The time conversion and substitution follow source Foundation Q3(c).
